identity.title: Native receipt validator has an impossible artifact-role denominator

values.goal: Make native Runtime v3 receipt validation order-independent while preserving fail-closed revision and digest checks.
values.required_outcome: Valid role sets pass regardless of order, duplicate roles fail, verifier-only post-proof changes are accepted, and product changes are rejected.
authority_boundary: Runtime v3 native receipt packet schema and digests
operator_constraints: Do not modify or rerun Runtime v3 product soak work
Do not touch the active WP-03 worktree
Use only focused validation and FastWork storage
